text: {"status":"answered","answer":"This is a known issue: in the mobile app, bill pay returns error BP-503 when a payment is scheduled more than 30 days in the future. The workaround (per the Contact Centre Call Notes, August 2026 supervisor note) is to schedule the payment from the desktop online banking site, which isn't affected. Deleting and reinstalling the app won't help. A permanent fix ships in app release 7.14, and we log each occurrence with wrap-up code DIG-BP503.","cited_chunk_ids":["call_notes_2026_08::layout::B_structure::0000","call_notes_2026_08::layout::B_structure::0002"],"reason":"The supervisor note explicitly states the BP-503 cause, workaround, and fix release."}
